entries.reason: The checked-in runtime rejects the public entity-field definition/owner combination before an attribute is created.
entries.evidence: PK_ATTDEF_create returned PK_ERROR_wrong_entity_in_list (357) for the body and part owner contracts; no legal entity-field fixture was produced.
entries.recheckWhen: A documented legal owner/field combination for PK_ATTRIB_field_entity_c is available.

entries.reason: The tested version-2 definition with an explicit one-element field-size array is rejected before an attribute definition is returned.
entries.evidence: PK_ATTDEF_create_2 returned error 350 for a body-owned real field; the legacy PK_ATTDEF_create path is the stable producer used by the successful cases.
entries.recheckWhen: The runtime documents the required field-name/size encoding for PK_ATTDEF_sf_2_t.

entries.reason: Setting group-closing on the standard body-owned definition is rejected by the checked-in runtime.
entries.evidence: PK_ATTDEF_set_group_closing returned error 914 after PK_ATTDEF_create; no persistent attribute fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A documented grouped-attribute definition and compatible owner are available.

notes: The body-owned integer attribute case is currently the first verified custom attribute branch.
Additional owner classes, field types, arrays and action combinations remain separate cases and must not be inferred from this case.
